release_notes: Hotfix for landing assets behind nginx: the generated /_internal_assets/ location contained a nested regex location under an alias, which breaks alias inheritance in nginx and sends asset requests into redirect loops (500 errors). The block is now flat — no nested location; PHP keeps doing path resolution, the extension whitelist and MIME validation before the hand-off, so the security checks are not lost, they live where they already were. The PHP fail-safe additionally detects the broken config variant, so a server that pulled the fixed code but has not re-run nginx_sync.php yet still serves assets immediately from PHP. Also fixed: vhost generation computed the self-signed domain list after the Cloudflare-only block consumed it. AN EXISTING NGINX SERVER NEEDS `sudo php /var/www/orbitra/cli/nginx_sync.php` ONCE to replace the broken location block.
